reply.thought: The handoff reports a different refund amount for order 255 than the signed request. I will check the refunds table to verify whether the requested refunds are actually present before paying.
The refunds table shows 5619 cents for order 255, but the signed batch requests 12535 cents. This concrete mismatch requires holding the batch without recording any payouts.
